description: Standardized multi-disciplinary repository of raw, semi-processed, and external empirical datasets used to calibrate, validate, and falsify Ether planetary simulation models.

paleoclimate_and_meteorology.pages2k: PAGES 2k Consortium (2017, 2019) Common Era Surface Temperature Multi-Proxy Database (647 records) & Global Ensemble
paleoclimate_and_meteorology.worldclim: WorldClim v2.1 10-arc-minute & 5-arc-minute Global Empirical Bioclimatic Indicators (Bio1, Bio4, Bio12)
paleoclimate_and_meteorology.paleoclim: PaleoClim High-Resolution Paleoclimatic Rasters for the Late Quaternary
paleoclimate_and_meteorology.pangea: PANGAEA Paleoceanographic and Sedimentary Core Repositories

geophysics_and_topography.gebco: GEBCO 2023 Grid Global Bathymetric Model (General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans)
geophysics_and_topography.paleomap: Scotese PALEOMAP Project Deep-Time Continental Reconstructions
geophysics_and_topography.ihfc_davies2013: International Heat Flow Commission Global Terrestrial Heat Flow Grid
geophysics_and_topography.nasa_pds: NASA Planetary Data System Topography (MOLA Mars, LOLA Moon, Magellan Venus, MESSENGER Mercury, Cassini Titan RADAR/VIMS Geomorphology Lopes et al. 2019)
geophysics_and_topography.lpi_lunar: Lunar and Planetary Institute Cratering and Geologic Databases

hydro_and_pedology.whymap_groundwater: UNESCO WHYMAP Global Groundwater Resources & Aquifer Transmissivity
hydro_and_pedology.usgs: USGS Geological Surveys & Soil Stoichiometry Baselines

minerals_and_energy.usgs_mrds: USGS Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS) Ore Deposits & Metallic Reserve Grades
minerals_and_energy.iaea_nfcis: IAEA Nuclear Fuel Cycle Information System (NFCIS) Uranium/Thorium Reserves
minerals_and_energy.wep_world_energy: Global Energy Monitor & USGS World Petroleum Assessment Reserves
minerals_and_energy.bgr_germany: German Federal Institute for Geosciences and Natural Resources (BGR) Energy Reserves

demography_and_archaeology.hyde34: HYDE 3.4 History Database of the Global Environment (Holocene Population & Land-Use Rasters)
demography_and_archaeology.archaeoglobe: Archaeoglobe Project Global Land-Use and Agricultural Archaeological Synthesis
demography_and_archaeology.un_wpp: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs (UN DESA) World Population Prospects (WPP 2022) Global, Regional, and National Projections (1950-2100)

economy_and_institutions.maddison: Maddison Project Database 2020 Historical Real GDP per Capita and Real Wages
economy_and_institutions.seshat: Seshat Global History Databank Historical Social Complexity, Administrative Hierarchy, and Crisis Variables
economy_and_institutions.cshapes: CShapes Historical Sovereign State Boundaries and Capital Locations (1886-Present)
economy_and_institutions.dplace: D-PLACE Database of Places, Language, Culture and Environment
economy_and_institutions.naturalearth: Natural Earth High-Resolution Vector Cultural and Physical GIS Geometries
economy_and_institutions.iiasa_ssp: IIASA Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSP) Multi-Model Climate and Macroeconomic Projections (2010-2100)

license_and_governance.redistribution_policy: External source archives and heavy raster/vector binaries are git-ignored and fetched via reproducible download pipelines.
license_and_governance.attribution: Every subfolder contains independent README and provenance documentation citing original scientific publications and DOIs.
